name: Block Drop Battle
hook: Clear lines to send junk to your rival.
how: Falling blocks, like the classic. Clear two or more lines at once and a rival gets junk rows at the bottom. Last board standing wins.
controls: Arrow keys and Space, or tap to rotate, swipe to move, swipe down to drop
uses: You see every rival's board move as they play.
The host's browser runs the match: who is out, the winner and the restart. If it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill empty seats and stack and clear lines like a decent player.
The most lines each player sent in one match.
ideas: Make it four players who pick a target
